followup_reviews.Separate challenger: GPT-6 Astra Pro /root, separate same-model context
followup_reviews.Research finding: Retain the Myawaddy–Mae Sot parent with two held, differently scoped phases. Cargo interruption and the temporary-document admission issue are documented, but source conflicts remain material. Keep Bridge II cargo separate from Bridge I temporary-pass/booklet passage. Passport exceptions, broader Myanmar-side closure accounts and the direction of permitted return traffic conflict; do not replace them with one all-persons or both-directions statement. Keep P1’s April 11–20 onset bounds and April 30 cargo return held without a numeric interval. Keep P2 as the April 21 document-cohort observation without matching restoration. Generic Bridge I reopening cannot end this precise cohort restriction. Retain Security / Armed conflict and military confrontation for the cargo phase only. Conflict context does not by itself resolve the imposing authority or assign an official motive to every Bridge I document refusal. RFA, Eleven, Mizzima, GNLM and CNI supply materially different accounts; GNLM, Mizzima and CNI are substantive indexed passages where direct access failed earlier. Their differing origins are disclosed, and apparent majority agreement is not used to erase contradictions. Retain separate unlocated Bridge I and Bridge II text with null coordinates. Side, document cohort and bridge identity stay separate; a later nine-month shutdown is not backdated into the 2024 phase.
followup_reviews.Challenge verdict: Accepted within the root decision; see frozen challenge
followup_reviews.Challenge finding: Challenge packet SHA-256: 5f1d3f3dce2952c586309f6c110885b4729fb600d77b8a48a09580d96f094b45. Per-question challenge findings remain in that packet.
followup_reviews.Root decision: Accept the complete fixed16-parent/19-phase audit with20 guarded native/text changes. Remove H06’s stale blanket status, retain unresolved/held phases and narrow EU027’s numeric phase to supported land-road scope. Audit completion records the review, not universal factual confirmation.
followup_reviews.Issue dispositions: REC50-R40-Q13 — Cargo onset and side, passenger authority/direction, passport exceptions and temporary-pass restoration remain unresolved. Both held flags and the current queue remain open.
